title: Reality Research
tagline: A laboratory for testing attention, randomness and coincidence that is built to show you when nothing happened.
stateNote: The hosted app loads. Accounts and group sessions depend on a backend I haven't verified.
problem: Claims about consciousness and coincidence are usually easy to believe and hard to check. Each instrument here records real trials, keeps a control, and reports honestly, including how often pure noise looks significant.
audience: Curious skeptics and curious believers who want to run an experiment themselves in about twenty seconds.
contribution: It is my project: the instruments, the pre-registration approach and the interface are built to behave like a scientific instrument and not a dashboard.
worksToday: Eight instruments, including a blinded target guess and a baseline auditor that runs null experiments.
The first experiment needs no account and takes twenty seconds.
A prediction vault, a synchronicity log and a data explorer record what you did.
limitations: It is a research toy, not research. Nothing here is a scientific result.
Group sessions and accounts need the backend, which I haven't checked.
